svg.title: From $1,600 Gross to About $700 Real Net Per Car
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-gig-rental-gross-to-net-funnel; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: From $1,600 Gross to About $700 Real Net Per Car; subtitle: Monthly economics of a cheap economy car rented weekly to gig drivers; caption: Etienne Elsaesser strips the influencer math on a $3,000-$6,000 Corolla-class rental down to about $700 net per car per month once insurance, maintenance, a total-loss reserve, processing, and cleaning are paid.; assumptions note: Gross and net endpoints are as stated by Etienne Elsaesser; intermediate stages are simple subtraction of the stated deductions, and insurance is reported as $300 or more, so the post-insurance stage is an upper bound.; note: Etienne Elsaesser (amfsF8yd5hg @ 00:06:15, l8b3Oi2g48I @ 00:00:00); $400+ per week yielding a $1,600 monthly minimum per Alex Auto (Sukdr8-ecMM @ 00:05:14).; stages: label: Monthly gross at $400+ per week; value: 1600; display: $1,600; conversion: Starting gross; detail: Weekly rent of $350-$450 paid upfront; Alex Auto cites a $1,600 monthly minimum.; label: After insurance; value: 1300; display: About $1,300; conversion: Less $300+ insurance; detail: Insurance runs $300 or more per car per month.; label: After maintenance; value: 1100; display: About $1,100; conversion: Less about $200 maintenance; detail: Routine maintenance runs about $200 per car per month.; label: After total-loss reserve; value: 900; display: About $900; conversion: Less $200 total-loss reserve; detail: A $200 monthly reserve funds the car that eventually gets totaled.; label: Real net per car; value: 700; display: About $700; conversion: Less processing and cleaning; detail: Payment processing and cleaning close the gap to about $700 net.
